aboutHeading: 45 Years of Plumbing Excellence in Greensborough
aboutText: Lower Plenty Plumbing Service has been delivering expert plumbing solutions to Greensborough and Melbourne wide for over 45 years. Mitch and Mark lead a professional, fully qualified team specialising in all aspects of plumbing, drainage, roofing, gas fitting, and emergency repairs. Whether you need residential maintenance or commercial civil works, we have the skill and know-how to get the project done. Proudly trusted on The Block Oslo 2019.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of plumbing services tailored for both residential and commercial clients across Greensborough and greater Melbourne. Every job is backed by our 45 years of industry experience.
